description: This file defines the NetworkConfig singleton object that manages the backend base URL configuration for the application, providing a method to retrieve the properly formatted base URL with trailing slash.

classes.name: NetworkConfig
classes.description: Singleton object that manages network configuration, particularly the backend base URL.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the backend base URL, using the configured value if available, otherwise falling back to the default. Ensures the URL ends with a slash.
